svg.text: Component-side view • same orientation as your photo • USB left, antenna right
Colored lines show electrical connections; install these insulated wires on the underside.
• A–G / 1–18 are the NEW coordinates from the earlier strip diagram, not the printed board labels.
• ESP32/header position is illustrative: use actual pads marked GND, 5V and 4, not drawn hole positions.
• Only wire endpoints connect. Crossings and bends do not connect to the pads beneath them.
• Identify transistor E/B/C before fitting. Capacitor + goes to 5V; − goes to GND.
• Remove ESP32 and unplug USB while wiring. Dry-fit components and check clearances first.
